title: candidate.rejected
description: An attempt that did not get a full verification, with the reason. These are the main feedback for later lab assistants and the source of hit-rate statistics. `cause` is the program.committed. Subject is prog:<program>.

circuit.description: Circuit digest, if it was built.

reason.description: Why it stopped: the generator failed, the cheap check failed, it was a near-copy of a program already in the island, or it passed the cheap check but would not beat its bucket. verify_error: the verifier itself failed on this program (timeout, out of memory, internal error); it is recorded so the verifier moves on instead of retrying forever.

detail.description: Error text or explanation, trimmed. Shown to later lab assistants in their island summary.
